entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I bought something a while ago and I think I need to return it. I'm a bit confused about how it all works.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Mark Peterson, and the order was... let me see... 772-V-901.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero-Vent helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?

Oh, a preference, I guess? The color just wasn't right when I saw it in person. My wife says it doesn't match my bike at all. The website was so complicated, I just... I don't know what to do. The box is still unopened. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Mark. I completely understand. It's important that you're happy with your gear, especially an item so crucial for your safety. Let me just confirm the return eligibility based on your purchase date.
Alright, I've checked our policy. It looks like you received the helmet 79 days ago, so you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's a relief. So you can take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now, and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. Since the box is unopened, all you'll need to do is attach that label and drop it at your local post office. We'll issue a full refund as soon as it's received back at our warehouse.
Wow, that's great. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a huge help.
It's my pleasure, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
